top_choice_rationale: P005 (gamma-ray burst afterglows, Costa, Frontera, Kulkarni) is a discovery delivered by nature that has stood for nearly three decades: BeppoSAX localisation enabled afterglow, host and redshift measurements that settled the cosmological origin of bursts, with no maturity question. The credit gap (van Paradijs deceased, Groot) is real but can be handled by wording the citation around afterglows and cosmological origin. P002 (twisted bilayer graphene, three names) is next as a clean prediction-then-observation chain, though the pairing mechanism is still open; P003 (lattice clocks) is a capability and close to earlier clock prizes; P001 has unsettled attribution and a payoff still to come; P004 is narrow and near the 2007 spintronics prize. A prize is better than none.
